ticks.note: Tick 1 enters the initial state of each region: `Idle` in `Oven`, `Dark` in `Lamp`.

`Oven` starts cooking and sets `heating`. `Lamp` reads `heating` in the same tick, sees true and switches `lamp` on. Regions react together, and a region sees what another has written in the same tick.
The door opens. `Oven` switches `heating` off and goes to `DoorOpen`. `Lamp` stays in `Lit`, because the door is open.
The door shuts. `Oven` returns to `Idle`, and `Lamp`, seeing neither the door nor `heating`, goes dark.
